description: Enrich a developer from their GitHub profile URL — full firmographic + technical profile, computed in real time (cached server-side after the first call). Returns name, location, company, bio, followers/following, repo and gist counts, years active, seniority estimate, a ranked skills breakdown (languages by repo share), top repos, 90-day activity counts, and composite scores (seniority, activity, language diversity, influence, profile completeness). Flat 2 credits per successful call. Use to enrich a lead or candidate you already have a GitHub URL for. Requires your own Revternal API key (BYOK) — pass it as _apiKey. Example: revternal_enrich_developer({ github_url: "https://github.com/torvalds", _apiKey: "..." }).

_apiKey.description: Your Revternal API key (sent as x-api-key), from https://revternal.com/signup. Required — Pipeworx has no platform key for this pack.
